name: developer-identity-not-in-worktrees
title: The developer identity file is gitignored, so every fresh worktree fails record-session
description: .trellis/.developer is gitignored (correctly), so it is never materialized in a new worktree and get_developer (common/paths.py:69) — the resolver all callers delegate to — reads only the worktree-local file. The remedy the tooling prints, init_developer.py, writes a second worktree-local identity rather than reusing the primary checkout's, silently forking the identity the journal path derives from. Fix the resolver to fall back to the primary checkout; keep the file uncommitted. Vendored Trellis code, so upstream-handoff-first. Makes the .trellis/.developer part of 08-07-sd-submit-pack-task requirement 8 redundant; the rest of that requirement stands.
creator: sdelmas
